body:
O my god I still feel this junk... WOW. Lemme start with the first trip, lol I'm hallucinating like crazy!
Okay on Wed.(cant remember)2001, I took 12 benedryls and 5 tylenol PM's, and didnt feel it till like 3 hours later, but when I did, I traveled (took like an hour) out to the living room because I was paranoid, and we only have two other people in the house (it was like 4 in the morning,lol)and one cat named Wubby (my sisters,doesnt belong to her anymore) and I layed on the couch and turned on the TV, and my friend was in the den, and said TURN OFF THE TV, very loud, this scared the fudge outta me, and I saw all these colors when that happened!
Anyways I saw like 5 cats wwalking around the sofa table (almost completely dark) and then the scariest (not really) hallucination came slowly floating down the hall, I couldnt make it out, but then I saw and it was my grandma (this hallucination happened like 8 times) then she just stopped, and if I said any words she (they) would just stare at me until I charged at them! Another person I hallucinated came from a plastic tree, then it turned into my dad, and it was walking around my room eating chips, and I said wtf do u want? And he turned his head and starred at me! So I walked back to the living room and stepped outside, and all these beavers started running at me, and chased me around in slow motion outside for about 15 minutes, I said WHOA, because I am a very experianced user with acid, shroom, (I cant type I'm still at my peak with my hallucanated grandma starring at me...) and this didnt even compare, because with acid you see things move and sh*t but with, shrooms you dream them, DMX was more vivid, and reality mixed with your hallucinations, for example, you see a kitchen knife slowly move out of its sheath and come racing at at you and stick in the wall behind you, then you look back at the sheath and its there, and you look back at the wall and its gone!
It is a very very very strong drugs, I had (still having) a way outta this world experince, it was like taking 10 acid hits at once!!!!!! MAN I'm GONE!!!!!!
OK that was my first trip, well last night (the day after the first trip) I doubled the dose and......... WOW I fell asleep(thankfully because the hallucinations I had were very scary) but I still woke up from time to time, and one time I woke up and I walked out my door and then all these elves started walking towards me and stuff, I was gone as fudge! I ran back in my room only to find the elf queen and king on my bed screwing each other, at this point a knocked out beside them on the bed and they scampered out of my room, and this morning when I woke up, I saw an elf looking through my backyard window starring at me, and when I tape the window it ran away behind a bush!!!
All I can say is if you really want a nice trip, take exaclty this(not as big as my dosage) take about 9 benedryls, and 2 tylenol PM's, that will make anybody hallucinate, Be careful and have fun, because I'm still chasing gnomes in my house, bye all!
